l.i: Hortatio ad Scholasticum, ne literis ad amicoi traducat Præceptores, veritatis nomine.

main_text.l: EXordium sit πάθος. Dolere tibi, quod de ipso mutare cogaris judicium.
Ratio: quia hactenus cum habueris pro modesto juvene: nunc deprehendas arrogantem, inq; præceptores ingratum esse.
Narratio habens αὐλολογίαν: Incidisse te nuper in literas ipsius ad familiarem scriptas: quibus de severitate disciplinæ graviter conqueratur, & de præceptoribus parum honorificè scribat.
Propositio. Hortari te cum, ne disciplinam & præceptores traducat:

Ratio 1. quia diligens legum defensio præceptoribus incumbat ex officio. Amplificetur a necessitate hujus diligentiæ ob crescentem petulantiam & vanitatem juventutis. Item a contraria Thesi: licentiam stultidis adolescentibus gratam, sed perniciosam esse.
Ratio II. quia nullam habeat conquerendi causam.
Probatio 1. quia scias, in schola ejus disciplinam longe arctiorem legib. sanciri, & olim utiliter viguisse, quam nunc sit.
Prob. 2. quia ex aliis cognoveris, præceptores ejus erga bonos benevolos esse: severos tantum erga petulantes, ex quibus ipse esse non debeat.

page.notes: The Greek words "πάθος" after "Exordium sit" and "αὐλολογίαν" are transcribed from the scan as best read; the Greek heading word after "Exordium sit" is doubtful and may be a different word. Probable printing irregularities left as printed: "ad amicoi", "legib. sanciri", "stultidis". Text in the first line "Doler" and "ex quibus" read with some uncertainty. The paragraph marked "Ratio 3" is a heading-like label set in the text and left as a paragraph.
